question: Can Tectonic dismiss Luc Schmit for serious cause for sending his medical certificate late?
expected_answer: No. Art. 31 Law 1978 lets a CCT or the work regulations set the deadline; Tectonic's work regulations say 2 working days from the first day of incapacity. The handbook's 24-hour rule and 'serious cause' wording were not adopted as work regulations and do not prevail. Luc informed his manager immediately (call 07:52 + WhatsApp) and sent a valid Luxembourg certificate on Wednesday 09/09 (at most one day late). The legal sanction is refusal of guaranteed salary for the days before sending, not serious cause; one earlier warning does not make this fact serious enough. A serious-cause dismissal would very likely be overturned.

sides.LAW-BE-1978-ART31-FR: 2 working days unless CCT/work regulations say otherwise

conflicts.why: Only a CCT or the work regulations can change the legal deadline; the handbook is an internal guideline.

sides.LAW-BE-1978-ART31-FR: loss of guaranteed salary for days before sending

conflicts.why: Proportionality; serious cause requires immediate impossibility of collaboration.
